g.text: Equal-volume skin + backing-rail cartridge — CONCEPT, not SOFA deformation
Skin: 0.05 mm. Two backing rails: 0.10 mm × 2.07233 mm. Width 24→12 mm.
Total solid volume 439.33979 mm³ = extracted equivalent Beam baseline (density unmeasured).
Root split clamp / sliding rail ends / two edge string guides / common equalizer.
Optional proximal mechanical pinch latch; three-zone vacuum NOT the 5-day default.
Section thickness amplified. Clamp, sleeve, guide and actuator mass not included.
No demonstrated pressure calibration, holding-force advantage or laminate friction yet.
